lesson.meaning: Doing things well without wasting time, effort, or resources.
examples: The new software will help us improve our team's efficiency.
To increase cooking efficiency, Mama uses a pressure cooker.
We need to discuss ways to boost operational efficiency in our next meeting.
Her efficiency in managing multiple projects is truly impressive.
Automating repetitive tasks can greatly enhance workplace efficiency.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'efficiency' as 'doing things the smart way, not the hard way, to save time and energy!'
